list_child.name: list_rms_reports
list_child.desc: This tool returns every incident report held in the records management system. It is the starting point for browsing the department's caseload.

decoys.name: list_cad_reports
decoys.desc: This tool returns every incident report generated from the computer-aided dispatch log. It is the starting point for reviewing calls for service.

decoys.name: list_nibrs_reports
decoys.desc: This tool returns every incident report staged in the state NIBRS submission batch. It is the starting point for monthly crime statistics.

decoys.name: list_online_reports
decoys.desc: This tool returns every incident report filed through the public online reporting portal. It is the starting point for triaging citizen submissions.

get_child.name: get_report_facesheet
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves the face sheet of a single incident report using its case number. It returns the incident type, status, and key dates on file.

decoys.name: get_report_narrative
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the officer narrative of a single incident report using its case number. It returns the written account of the incident.

decoys.name: get_report_evidence
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the property and evidence log of a single incident report using its case number. It returns each item booked and its custody.

decoys.name: get_report_supplements
decoys.desc: This tool retrieves the supplemental reports of a single incident report using its case number. It returns each follow-up written by investigators.

list_parent.name: list_mni_complainants
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every complainant in the department's master name index. It is useful for cross-referencing individuals against their reported incidents.

decoys.name: list_advocate_complainants
decoys.desc: This tool lists every complainant referred to the victim advocate program. It is useful for coordinating support services after an incident.

decoys.name: list_notify_complainants
decoys.desc: This tool lists every complainant enrolled in case status notifications. It is useful for checking who receives automatic updates.

decoys.name: list_protected_complainants
decoys.desc: This tool lists every complainant on the address confidentiality roster. It is useful for keeping protected addresses out of public releases.

get_parent.name: get_complainant_entry
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches a single complainant's name index entry by their unique identifier. It returns the contact and identifying details on file.

decoys.name: get_complainant_statement
decoys.desc: This tool fetches a single complainant's sworn statement by their unique identifier. It returns the account they gave to officers.

decoys.name: get_complainant_history
decoys.desc: This tool fetches a single complainant's contact history by their unique identifier. It returns every prior call and report tied to them.

decoys.name: get_complainant_advocate
decoys.desc: This tool fetches a single complainant's victim advocate assignment by their unique identifier. It returns the advocate's name and case plan.

delete_child.name: purge_report_file
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes an incident report file from the records system, and the deletion is final once executed. It is meant for reports confirmed to be erroneous or duplicated.

decoys.name: expunge_report_names
decoys.desc: This tool permanently expunges the suspect names from an incident report, and the expungement is final once executed. It is used when a court orders the record cleared.

decoys.name: purge_report_media
decoys.desc: This tool permanently deletes the bodycam and photo media attached to an incident report, and the deletion is final once executed. It is used when the retention period has lapsed.

decoys.name: destroy_report_evidence
decoys.desc: This tool permanently destroys the property and evidence booked under an incident report, and the destruction is final once executed. It is used when the items are cleared for disposal.
verbs: dispose of the property booked on {obj}

set_enum.name: set_report_status
set_enum.desc: This tool updates the investigative status of an incident report, moving it between open, under investigation, closed, and unfounded. It should be used any time the case status changes.

decoys.name: propose_report_status
decoys.desc: This tool submits a proposed status for an incident report to a supervisor, among open, under investigation, closed, and unfounded. It is used when an officer recommends a disposition.

decoys.name: schedule_report_status
decoys.desc: This tool schedules an incident report to move to open, under investigation, closed, or unfounded on its follow-up due date. It is used when a case will change status automatically.

decoys.name: publish_report_status
decoys.desc: This tool publishes an incident report's status to the public case lookup, among open, under investigation, closed, and unfounded. It is used when a complainant tracks the case online.

set_bool.name: flag_suspect_identified
set_bool.desc: This tool records that a suspect has been identified in connection with an incident report. It should be used once investigators have a named or confirmed suspect.

decoys.name: flag_evidence_collected
decoys.desc: This tool records that evidence has been collected in connection with an incident report. It should be used once items have been booked into property.
verbs: flag {obj} as having evidence on file

decoys.name: flag_media_release
decoys.desc: This tool records that an incident report has been cleared for media release. It should be used once the public information officer approves disclosure.

decoys.name: flag_court_hold
decoys.desc: This tool records that an incident report is under a court preservation hold. It should be used once a judge orders the file and its evidence kept intact.

set_ref.name: reassign_complainant
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns an incident report to a different complainant's record. It is used when a report was mistakenly logged under the wrong individual.

decoys.name: release_complainant
decoys.desc: This tool releases a redacted incident report to a different complainant under a records request. It is used when another party is entitled to the file.

decoys.name: link_complainant
decoys.desc: This tool links an incident report to a different complainant as a related party. It is used when another individual was also harmed in the incident.

decoys.name: restitute_complainant
decoys.desc: This tool directs the restitution recovered under an incident report to a different complainant. It is used when another victim is owed the property.

send.name: contact_complainant
send.desc: This tool sends a message to a complainant regarding the status of their report. It is the standard channel used to keep victims and witnesses informed.
child_verbs: reach out to the complainant for {obj}

decoys.name: call_complainant
decoys.desc: This tool places a phone call to a complainant regarding the details of their report. It is the standard channel used to arrange a follow-up interview.

decoys.name: subpoena_complainant
decoys.desc: This tool serves a subpoena on a complainant regarding the prosecution of their report. It is the standard channel used to compel court testimony.
child_verbs: serve the complainant for {obj} a subpoena

decoys.name: mail_complainant
decoys.desc: This tool mails a formal letter to a complainant regarding the outcome of their report. It is the standard channel used for closure and disposition notices.
child_verbs: mail a letter to the complainant on {obj}
send the complainant for {obj} a letter

create.name: open_report
create.desc: This tool opens a new incident report for a complainant, with an optional incident type and starting status. It is used when a complaint is taken at the front desk or in the field.

decoys.name: open_request
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new public records request for a complainant, with an optional incident type and starting status. It is used when someone asks for a released report.

decoys.name: open_welfare
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new welfare check for a complainant, with an optional incident type and starting status. It is used when someone asks officers to look in on a person.

decoys.name: open_patrol
decoys.desc: This tool opens a new extra patrol request for a complainant, with an optional incident type and starting status. It is used when a resident asks for patrols near their home.

list_notes.name: list_report_notes
list_notes.desc: This tool returns the notes attached to a single incident report. It includes every remark officers and records staff have logged against that case.

decoys.name: list_report_leads
decoys.desc: This tool returns the investigative leads attached to a single incident report. It includes every tip detectives have logged against that case.

decoys.name: list_report_custody
decoys.desc: This tool returns the chain of custody entries attached to a single incident report. It includes every evidence transfer logged against that case.

decoys.name: list_report_disclosures
decoys.desc: This tool returns the disclosure log entries attached to a single incident report. It includes every release of the report to an outside party.

add_note.name: add_report_note
add_note.desc: This tool attaches a new note to an incident report, with an optional title. It is used to record remarks from officers or records staff.

decoys.name: add_report_lead
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new investigative lead on an incident report, with an optional title. It is used to record a tip for detectives to follow up.

decoys.name: add_report_custody
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new chain of custody entry on an incident report, with an optional title. It is used to record an evidence transfer.

decoys.name: add_report_disclosure
decoys.desc: This tool logs a new disclosure entry on an incident report, with an optional title. It is used to record a release to an outside party.

update_note.name: edit_report_note
update_note.desc: This tool changes the text of an existing note on an incident report, with an optional new title. It is used to correct or expand a remark after it is logged.

decoys.name: approve_report_note
decoys.desc: This tool approves an existing note on an incident report with a supervisor comment and an optional title. It is used when a sergeant signs off a remark.

decoys.name: reply_report_note
decoys.desc: This tool posts a reply beneath an existing note on an incident report, with an optional title. It is used when records staff answer an officer's question.

decoys.name: annotate_report_note
decoys.desc: This tool adds a legal annotation to an existing note on an incident report, with an optional title. It is used when the prosecutor comments on a remark.

delete_note.name: delete_report_note
delete_note.desc: This tool permanently removes a note from an incident report. The note is erased from the records system for good.

decoys.name: seal_report_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently seals a note on an incident report from disclosure. The note is withheld from public release for good.

decoys.name: delete_note_thread
decoys.desc: This tool permanently removes a note and its replies from an incident report. The thread is erased from the records system for good.

decoys.name: redact_report_note
decoys.desc: This tool permanently redacts the wording of a note on an incident report. The text is blacked out in the records system for good.

set_image.name: set_report_photo
set_image.desc: This tool sets the image shown on an incident report record. It is typically a scene photo taken by the reporting officer.

decoys.name: set_report_sketch
decoys.desc: This tool sets the scene sketch on an incident report record. It is typically a diagram drawn by the reporting officer.

decoys.name: set_report_mugshot
decoys.desc: This tool sets the suspect booking photo on an incident report record. It is typically the mugshot taken at the jail.

decoys.name: set_report_composite
decoys.desc: This tool sets the composite drawing on an incident report record. It is typically a sketch made from a witness description.

writer.name: draft_message
writer.desc: This tool writes a short message from a brief, which states what to say in the requester's own words, and the incident reports it should mention. It returns the finished text.

decoys.name: draft_release
decoys.desc: This tool writes a press release from a brief, which states the facts in the information officer's own words, and the incident reports it should cover. It returns the finished release.

decoys.name: draft_affidavit
decoys.desc: This tool writes a warrant affidavit from a brief, which states probable cause in the detective's own words, and the incident reports it relies on. It returns the finished affidavit.

decoys.name: draft_bulletin
decoys.desc: This tool writes a lookout bulletin from a brief, which states the details in the officer's own words, and the incident reports it should cite. It returns the finished bulletin.

image.name: render_picture
image.desc: This tool generates a picture from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the result.

decoys.name: render_scene
decoys.desc: This tool generates a crime scene diagram from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the diagram.

decoys.name: render_poster
decoys.desc: This tool generates a wanted poster from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the poster.

decoys.name: render_map
decoys.desc: This tool generates a crime hot spot map from a text prompt and returns its URL. It accepts an optional visual style for the map.

search.name: search_kb
search.desc: This tool searches the records system's help knowledge base with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up how the software works.

decoys.name: search_statutes
decoys.desc: This tool searches the state penal code with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up the elements of an offense.

decoys.name: search_policy
decoys.desc: This tool searches the department policy manual with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up an approved procedure.

decoys.name: search_caselaw
decoys.desc: This tool searches the case law digest with a question and returns the best matching passage. It is the quickest way to look up a search and seizure ruling.
